{{Quote|The planet Oznek had more than its share of natural perils&hellip; most of them at least as dangerous as the battle droids.|[[Banks (clone)|Banks]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
This '''unidentified carnivore''' [[Species/Legends|species]] was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oznek]]. During a mission to the planet, one member of this species encountered a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and consumed [[Unidentified clone trooper (Oznek)|one of them]].
